work_dir.description: Base directory for output HTML and graph files

log_dir.description: Directory to store raw log files (.log) used by tools like log2rrd

snmp_interval.description: SNMP polling interval in minutes (must match cron job frequency)

snmp_timeout.description: SNMP timeout in seconds before retrying

snmp_default_authname.description: SNMP community string for devices that don’t specify one

snmp_default_authpass.description: Optional: SNMPv3 auth pass for default auth

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for host resolution

mail_alert_enabled.description: Enable global email alerts on threshold breaches

html_title.description: Title shown in HTML header for generated pages

html_directory.description: Root HTML output directory (if different from WorkDir)

png_directory.description: PNG graph output directory (if different from WorkDir)

threshold_enabled.description: Enable global threshold warning (applies to all targets)

threshold_value.description: Threshold in bytes for global alerts (applies to all targets)
